import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
open scoped BigOperators
theorem choose_zero_and_self (n : ℕ) : Nat.choose n 0 = 1 ∧ Nat.choose n n = 1 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem choose_zero_and_self (n : ℕ) : Nat.choose n 0 = 1 ∧ Nat.choose n n = 1
:= by
  split
  · rw [Nat.choose_zero]
  · rw [Nat.choose_self]
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : Nl2LeanExpected.choose_zero_and_self = Nl2LeanCandidate.choose_zero_and_self := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
